links.note: Written and frozen before any target curve is evaluated by these scripts. chi(l) for l <= 5003 of the target was seen in the prior study; the prediction is marked in_sample accordingly.

question: Does prime239v1's truncated Euler product for L(1, chi_Delta), taken over all primes l <= 10^6, remain extreme (below the 1st percentile) under the prime-order Chebotarev null?

claims.text: log P_Delta and log P_DK are exact sums of Kronecker-symbol terms for the 69 certified eligible curves.
prime239v1's log P_Delta lies below the 1st percentile of the prime-order null at X = 10^6.
claims.if_supported: the small-L(1,chi) reading of the split-count outlier survives; reopens only the CM-field question, no ECDLP claim
claims.if_not_supported: the split-prime line closes: prime239v1's L(1,chi) proxy is ordinary

hypotheses.statement: prime239v1's CM field has an unusually small L(1, chi_D), i.e. small class number relative to sqrt|D_K|.
hypotheses.mechanism: a CM-method generator would produce small |D_K|; few small split primes is a truncated small Euler product

data_seen.measured: prime239v1 split-count percentiles for 53 <= B <= 5003 (0.009% minimum near 571, 10.8% at 5003)

provenance.decisive_scope: the chi_Delta(l) terms for primes 5003 < l <= 10^6 of prime239v1 (never computed); chi(l) for l <= 5003 was seen in the prior study as split/inert/ramified counts

arms.description: the other 68 draft-eligible certified positions (descriptive comparison)
prime-order GL2 Chebotarev null per field (Monte Carlo l <= 1000, Gaussian above)

aa.not_applicable_reason: exact deterministic arithmetic; no measurement noise

positive.expected_detection: |log P_DK(secp256k1) - log(pi/(3 sqrt 3))| <= tau, tau = max |log P_X(D) - log L(1,chi_D)| over 2,000 calibrated discriminants; otherwise the run is invalid_measurement

null_population.description: prime-order curves over the same field: Frobenius mod l uniform on GL2(F_l), det p, no eigenvalue 1, independent over l
null_population.generator: analyze.null_probs (closed form, brute-force checked each run) + analyze.null_field
null_population.why_n: Monte Carlo resolution 1e-6 against a 1% threshold

factors.name: conductor
factors.how: chi_Delta decisive; chi_DK (conductor stripped per l) descriptive

comparisons.reason: publication label is not randomized and 61 of 69 curves were seen in earlier studies; descriptive only

randomization.arm_order_reason: exact arithmetic; order cannot affect a Kronecker symbol

seed_derivation.note: 20261030 null Monte Carlo and calibration; 20261031 descriptive permutation

blinding.how: single prespecified target; statistic, threshold and null fixed before data

power.note: one prespecified curve against an analytic null; Monte Carlo resolution 1e-6 << 0.01. No effect-size power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: estimate from the prior study's scripts on the same container class

primary.name: null percentile of log P_Delta
primary.definition: 100 * P(null log P_Delta < observed) for the target's field
primary.formula: mean over 10^6 Monte Carlo sums S_i (l <= 1000) of Phi((x - S_i - mu_tail)/sd_tail), mu/sd exact over 1000 < l <= 10^6

secondary.name: log Euler product, chi_Delta
secondary.definition: sum over primes l <= 10^6 of -log(1 - chi_Delta(l)/l)

secondary.name: log Euler product, chi_DK
secondary.definition: same with the l-part of the conductor stripped per l

stopping_rules.rule: fixed population, one pass; launch only after scripts/checkpoint.sh gate passes

invalidation_rules: self_test failure, a missing or uncertified position, branches disagreeing on Delta, or Delta not 5 mod 8 stops the run
positive control outside tau gives invalid_measurement

decision_rule.text: extreme_persists if prime239v1 pct_delta < 1.0; not_extreme if >= 1.0; invalid_measurement if the positive control fails.
decision_rule.interval: none (analytic null with Monte Carlo resolution 1e-6)
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: log P_Delta minus the null median

graphs: log P_Delta per field with the null density and prime239v1 marked

inadmissible: changing X, threshold, target, population or null after any target value is computed
reading the descriptive published/unpublished comparison as a test
reading any verdict as an ECDLP weakness

literature.claim: prime239v1 split-count percentile by cutoff; prime-order null
Frobenius mod N equidistribution underlying the null
literature.verified_by: model checked at 48 bits and on 42 real-field curves in the prior study
